subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose global cron restart catch-up controls, add a per-job missed-run policy, or keep the current internal-only catch-up knobs while fixing narrower scheduler bugs?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested solution adds a compatibility-sensitive public openclaw.json scheduler surface and changes the balance between duplicate deliveries and missed scheduled work.

options.title: Expose bounded global controls
options.body: Add validated global cron settings for max immediate missed jobs and stagger delay while preserving current defaults and documenting the exact zero-value behavior.

options.title: Design per-job missed-run policy
options.body: Add an explicit job-level skip/freshness policy so announcement jobs can skip stale catch-up while monitoring jobs can still replay missed work.

options.title: Keep internals private
options.body: Leave the internal deps unexposed and handle duplicate-delivery reports through narrower scheduler fixes such as schedule-activation or session-lane guards.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded global controls
recommendation.body: Add validated global cron settings for max immediate missed jobs and stagger delay while preserving current defaults and documenting the exact zero-value behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the merged restart-stagger implementation and follow-up startup catch-up refactor, and the remaining blocker is public config/product semantics.
